answer_1.quote: This paper focuses on Seq2Seq (S2S) constrained text generation where a set of encoder input tokens are required to be present in the generated outputs. For example, Keyword-to-Text, Data-to-Text and Image-to-Text...
answer_1.outputs: Generated texts satisfying lexical constraints (e.g., including specific keywords, key-value pairs, or image objects)

answer_2.quote: We report constraint satisfaction for all tasks. ... We report CIDEr and SPICE as generated text quality metrics. ... We report NIST, BLEU and METEOR as they are common metrics...

answer_4.quote: We select 100 output samples from the T5 baseline and our MF model in all three tasks (300 in total). For each sample pair, we ask three annotators to judge which sample is 'more human-like'.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators judge which sample is more human-like
